rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something located in or associated with the suburbs.

example.english: This suburban school has lots of green space.
example.traditional: 呢間郊區學校有好多綠地。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 gaau1 keoi1 hok6 haau6 jau5 hou2 do1 luk6 dei6

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress the outskirts of a city, especially in contrasts such as urban versus suburban.

example.english: Urban and suburban housing prices are very different.
example.traditional: 市區同市郊嘅樓價差好遠。
example.jyutping: si5 keoi1 tung4 si5 gaau1 ge3 lau4 gaa3 caa1 hou2 jyun5
